entities.name: Nezahal
entities.description: Aquatic elder dinosaur of Ixalan, a manifestation of blue mana and the depths of the sea.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Plane home to the elder dinosaurs.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city on Ixalan whose long hibernation held the elder dinosaurs in stasis.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Summoner who called the Elder Dinosaurs to battle the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Elder Dinosaurs
entities.description: Enormous dinosaurs of Ixalan, each embodying one aspect of the land's magic.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which the Elder Dinosaurs were summoned to fight.

events.summary: The opening of the golden city reveals the elder dinosaurs, held in stasis during Orazca's long hibernation.
events.quote: The opening of the golden city revealed the enormous elder dinosaurs

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Huatli summons Nezahal and the other Elder Dinosaurs to battle the invaders.
events.quote: Nezahal and the other Elder Dinosaurs were summoned by Huatli to battle the intruders.

relations.note: Huatli summoned Nezahal to fight the Phyrexians.
relations.quote: Nezahal and the other Elder Dinosaurs were summoned by Huatli to battle the intruders.
